rules.statement: Section 12 of the Partition Ordinance, No. 10 of 1863 preserves the rights of mortgagees regardless of whether they have mortgaged an entire land or an undivided share.
rules.supporting_quote: "The substantive part of that enactment is quite clear. It is: 'Nothing in this Ordinance contained shall affect the right of any mortgagee.'"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 12 of the Partition Ordinance, No. 10 of 1863
